faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Tehsildar Nawanshahr Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for Tehsildar Nawanshahr Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Court of Tehsildar, Nawanshahr, District Shaheed Bhagat Singh Nagar, by submitted (presented) in the court of tehsildar, nawanshahr, to reach by 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Tehsildar Nawanshahr Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Not specified in the notice; applications are invited from persons desirous of becoming the new Nambardar of village Kariam.

faq.question: Q4. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate must be a resident of Village Kariam.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications obtained from eligible candidates. Tehsildar recommends the name of the suitable candidate on the basis of merit. Case sent through the Sub Divisional Magistrate, Nawanshahr to the Deputy Commissioner's court. Fresh appointment ordered after Punjab and Haryana High Court decided CWP No. 18771 of 2016 on 12-08-2026.
